crossRefs.note: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He…
crossRefs.keyword: roughly to us. Heb. with us hard things

translations.web: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.
translations.bsb: “The man who is lord of the land spoke harshly to us and accused us of spying on the country.
translations.kjv: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
translations.asv: The man, the lord of the land, spake roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.
